correctness.rationale: Directly applying the derivation identity to [e2,e2]=e1 yields c=0 and a=2d, reconstructing the source matrix family exactly. For H=diag(2,1) and E with the single upper-right entry 1, direct multiplication gives [H,E]=E. Thus the lower central series has gamma_2=CE and gamma_n=CE for every n>=2, so the derivation Lie algebra is not nilpotent. The source definition of characteristically nilpotent is precisely nilpotence of Der_{alpha^0}(L), and alpha=id here.
